text:
elaine: Heads-up: vuln triage found CVE-2026-189 in libssl in our baseimage. We need a coordinated rebuild + signing + RBAC cutover. Low blast radius rollout preferred.
ajay: OK — can we avoid touching customer-facing images? propose staging-only rebuild then a canary in prod pool.
kevin: Oncall can take the canary window. What RBAC changes do we need for the keystore signer?
elaine: We need to add `serviceAccount:image-signer` to the staging keystore role binding, not prod yet. Also audit log retention increased to 90d for signer ops.
tess: How would the audit spike look? storage ops wants an estimate.
ajay: Ballpark: signing metadata ~ 5KB per image event. Expect ~200k events during rollout => ~1GB extra. Fine.
kevin: Who will run the cosign signing job and where does the KMS unwrap happen?
elaine: cosign job runs in builder pool; KMS unwrap via keystore-operator which needs access to kms:encrypt/decrypt and log:write. We'll open those for `image-signer` role in staging.
ajay: Will need a small RBAC doc snippet. Use this patch to staging binding:
```
kubectl patch rolebinding image-keystore-staging -p '{"subjects":[{"kind":"ServiceAccount","name":"image-signer","namespace":"infra-signing"}]}'
```
kevin: Can we do an emergency rollback if signing fails? plan?
elaine: Yes — fallback policy: builder pods skip signing and push to `staging-unsigned` repo. We’ll have an alert on signing failures > 5/min to pager.
tess: Who owns the incident runbook update? I can PR the runbook with the RBAC snippet and the alert thresholds.
elaine: Thanks. Assign to tess. Also we need to notify compliance for the audit retention bump.
signing-bot: signature created for baseimage:v2026-03-18 by image-signer@infra-signing (cosign), key-id: projects/redwood-kms/keys/signer-01
deploy-bot: canary image baseimage:v2026-03-18-canary deployed to pool:prod-canary-1
kevin: I verified the canary logs — signing step succeeded, audit entries present in splunk under `k8s.audit.image_sign` and show keystore principal `image-signer`.
ajay: Next steps: 1) roll staging -> run quick smoke tests, 2) open RBAC to prod in a timed window, 3) monitor audit + cost.
elaine: Plan to schedule the prod RBAC cutover tomorrow 1600 UTC. Oncall: @kevin please hold pager for the 2h window.
kevin: ack. I'll be online. :thumbsup:
tess: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infrasec/repo/pull/412 — includes RBAC patch, alert changes, and runbook note.
elaine: Great. If anyone sees signing failures after cutover, ping here and tag `#incidents` if we need to escalate.
kevin: one more ask — can we add a short `cosign verify` check in the smoke suite? snippet: `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood-kms/keys/signer-01 baseimage:v2026-03-18`
ajay: added to smoke.yml, will trigger in next pipeline.
elaine: closing loop — thanks team. I'll post a short postmortem if anything pops during the window.
